name: Tuya Water Heater
description: The `tuya` water heater platform creates a water heater device from a [Tuya](https://esphome.io/components/tuya/) component. It is meant for electric water heaters (boilers) whose Tuya MCU exposes on/off, temperature and mode as datapoints.

config_entries.label: Name
config_entries.description: The name for the water heater. At least one of **id** and **name** must be specified.

config_entries.label: Switch Datapoint
config_entries.description:
**Required — set at least one of:** `target_temperature_datapoint`, `switch_datapoint`.

The datapoint id number of the on/off switch. Turning the water heater off publishes the `OFF` mode; turning it on restores the last reported mode.

config_entries.label: Target Temperature Datapoint
config_entries.description:
**Required — set at least one of:** `target_temperature_datapoint`, `switch_datapoint`.

The datapoint id number of the target temperature.

config_entries.label: Icon
config_entries.description: Manually set the icon to use for the water heater in the frontend.

config_entries.label: ID
config_entries.description: Manually specify the ID for code generation. At least one of **id** and **name** must be specified.

config_entries.label: Current Temperature Datapoint
config_entries.description: The datapoint id number of the current temperature.

config_entries.label: Current Temperature Multiplier
config_entries.description: A multiplier applied to the incoming current temperature value. Defaults to `1.0`.

config_entries.label: Disabled By Default
config_entries.description: If true, this entity should not be added to any client's frontend, (usually Home Assistant) without the user manually enabling it (via the Home Assistant UI). Defaults to `false`.

config_entries.label: Eco Value
config_entries.description: The datapoint value that maps to the `ECO` mode.

config_entries.label: Electric Value
config_entries.description: The datapoint value that maps to the `ELECTRIC` mode.

config_entries.label: Entity Category
config_entries.description: The category of the entity. See [https://developers.home-assistant.io/docs/core/entity/#generic-properties](https://developers.home-assistant.io/docs/core/entity/#generic-properties) for a list of available options. Set to `""` to remove the default entity category.

config_entries.label: Gas Value
config_entries.description: The datapoint value that maps to the `GAS` mode.

config_entries.label: Heat Pump Value
config_entries.description: The datapoint value that maps to the `HEAT_PUMP` mode.

config_entries.label: High Demand Value
config_entries.description: The datapoint value that maps to the `HIGH_DEMAND` mode.

config_entries.label: Internal
config_entries.description: Mark this component as internal. Internal components will not be exposed to the frontend (like Home Assistant). Only specifying an `id` without a `name` will implicitly set this to true.

config_entries.label: Mode Datapoint
config_entries.description: The datapoint id number of the enum reporting the operating mode. When set, at least one `*_value` below must be provided.

config_entries.label: Performance Value
config_entries.description: The datapoint value that maps to the `PERFORMANCE` mode.

config_entries.label: Supported Modes
config_entries.description: Static list of operation modes that will be exposed to the frontend (for example Home Assistant). When not specified, all modes supported by the platform are exposed.

config_entries.label: Target Temperature Multiplier
config_entries.description: A multiplier applied to the incoming and outgoing target temperature values - [see below](https://esphome.io/components/water_heater/tuya/#temperature-multiplier). Defaults to `1.0`.

config_entries.label: Visual
config_entries.description: Configuration for the frontend representation.

config_entries.label: Max Temperature
config_entries.description: Override the maximum temperature shown in the frontend.

config_entries.label: Min Temperature
config_entries.description: Override the minimum temperature shown in the frontend.

config_entries.label: Target Temperature Step
config_entries.description: Override the temperature steps shown in the frontend.
